searchText: I implemented a good chunk of the EVM in Kotlin over here: https://github.com/apache/incubator-tuweni/pull/201 Feedback and contribs welcome. It's fast! Kotlin is such a comfortable language to read and work with. I miss it. Come and play - I have a lot more to cover all the hard forks. I have the devp2p stack done and even the synchronizer, but I certainly could use contribs for a transaction processor. Too busy at the moment to add *more* work to my plate. 😢 One more thing - this kotlin EVM is uniquely well placed to allow the creation of a DSL on top of it to allow folks to create smart contracts... I hear you!
